verdict.rationale: A direct probe fetched https://docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json and got HTTP 200 with a body containing an "openapi" key. That is concrete hands-on evidence that a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. An llms.txt index is also served, which helps AI-native consumers discover the docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the API the spec covers (endpoints, auth, versioning), and confirmation that the spec is complete and current for the public API rather than a partial docs artifact.
